title: Shared pinned derived counit normalization
statement: For a scheme morphism f:X→Y [def-pc-scheme], with the supplied derived-category family [def-pc-derived-category], let I be any homotopy complex on X. Let F be module direct image [def-pc-ringed-spaces-derived-direct-image], a_f the pinned adjunction [def-pc-t2-open-pinned-adjunction], and ε_f the left-derived counit supplied by the common derived pullback composition data [lem-pc-ringed-spaces-derived-pullback-composition]. Then derivedPullback(f).map(F.rightDerivedFunctorUnit(I)) followed by a_f.counit(Qh I) equals ε_f(F_h I) followed by Qh of the homotopy tensor-pullback adjunction counit at I [lem-pc-module-pullback-adjunction]. This holds without K-injectivity or an invertible right-derived unit.

proof.text: Apply injectivity of the derived Hom equivalence. Its inverse sends the right-derived unit to pullback of that unit followed by the derived counit. The pinned Hom-equivalence compatibility applied to the underived homotopy counit identifies the other image with Qh of the identity followed by the right-derived unit: homEquiv_symm_id and apply_symm_apply give the identity. Functor.map_id and id_comp identify the two images. The private categorical helper carries out this calculation for general compatible adjunctions and localizations, and specialization uses exactly exists_schemeDerivedAdjunction with the already chosen data.

lean.statement:
theorem singleComplexOpen_pinned_counit_unit
    [∀ Y : Scheme.{u},
      HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace))]
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    (I : HomotopyCategory (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)) (.up ℤ)) :
    let _ := (Classical.choose exists_derivedPullbackComposition) f
    let F := RingedSpace.moduleDirectImage f.toLRSHom.toShHom
    let a := @singleComplexOpenPinnedAdjunction.{u, w} _
    let ε := @Classical.choose _ _
      (Classical.choose_spec exists_derivedPullbackComposition)
    (derivedPullback f).map (F.rightDerivedFunctorUnit.app I) ≫
        (a f).counit.app (DerivedCategory.Qh.obj I) =
      (ε f).app ((F.mapHomotopyCategory (.up ℤ)).obj I) ≫
        DerivedCategory.Qh.map
          (((Classical.choose (Scheme.Modules.exists_tensorPullbackAdjunction f))
            |>.mapHomotopyCategory (.up ℤ)).counit.app I)
